data.one_liner: Retrieve a persistent unique device identifier across app reinstalls on mobile and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves a persistent unique device identifier (UDID) across app reinstalls on iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, and Linux. It utilizes platform-specific APIs and keychain persistence where applicable. It also provides a consistent hashing option to normalize formats across platforms.
use_when: You need a persistent device identifier across app reinstalls for analytics or tracking.
You need a unique hardware or system ID across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
avoid_when: You require an identifier that survives a factory reset.
You cannot tolerate privacy implications or store device-level IDs.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including mobile and desktop.
Persists across app reinstalls using platform keychain/storage features.
Provides a consistent format option across all platforms.
weaknesses: UDID can change after a factory reset.
May change on rooted/jailbroken devices or if app signing signature changes.
On iOS, requesting UDID before first unlock after reboot throws a PlatformException.
